## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Enforce the 12-character minimum for invitation passwords before merge. The invitation flow still allows passwords below the required minimum.

## Changes

The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimum from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical

- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the 12-character minimum for invites — An 11-character password rejected by the updated signup validator still passes invitation validation because `app/invite.py:1` sets the minimum to eight. — Invited users can create accounts with passwords below the required minimum. — Fix: Raise the minimum in `app/invite.py:1` and update `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py`.
